purpose: Research-only candidate trail overview for later import. Not runtime app data.

overview.summary: Kungsleden is a high-mountain long-distance trail between Abisko in Norrbotten and Hemavan in Vasterbotten. Official sources describe it as Sweden's oldest and best-known mountain hiking trail, established by STF in the early 20th century and now used as a major state trail through Lapland, national parks, the Laponia World Heritage area, and Vindelfjallen.
overview.candidateImportScope: Main Abisko-Hemavan Kungsleden hiking line only. Model Singi-Kebnekaise-Nikkaluokta, Vakkotavare-Kebnats-Saltoluokta, lake crossings and other access legs as connectors or access metadata unless later official evidence says they are part of the main hiking line.

officialDistanceClaims.distanceText: 107 km Abisko-Nikkaluokta, 102 km Nikkaluokta-Saltoluokta, 73 km Saltoluokta-Kvikkjokk, 180 km Kvikkjokk-Ammarnas, 78 km Ammarnas-Hemavan
officialDistanceClaims.caveat: The first two route groups include the Singi-Kebnekaise-Nikkaluokta access route and overlap; do not sum them as a full Abisko-Hemavan mainline.

officialSources.name: STF Kungsleden overview
keyFindings: Trail between Abisko and Hemavan, just over 450 km.
Passes through Abisko, Stora Sjofallet, Sarek and Pieljekaise national parks.
STF operates 16 mountain huts along Kungsleden; no STF huts between Kvikkjokk and Ammarnas.
Common start/end points include Abisko, Vakkotavare, Saltoluokta, Kvikkjokk, Ammarnas, Hemavan and Nikkaluokta.
Nikkaluokta is an access point; if starting there, STF says hikers reach Kungsleden after about two days.

officialSources.name: STF Abisko-Nikkaluokta route group
keyFindings: Lists seven day stages and 107 km total.
Explicitly states Singi-Nikkaluokta is not part of official Kungsleden.
Mainline candidate should use only Abisko-Abiskojaure, Abiskojaure-Alesjaure, Alesjaure-Tjaktja, Tjaktja-Salka, Salka-Singi from this page.

officialSources.name: STF Nikkaluokta-Saltoluokta route group
keyFindings: Lists Nikkaluokta-Saltoluokta as 102 km and 5-6 days.
Includes Nikkaluokta-Kebnekaise-Singi access stages before joining the main Kungsleden.
Includes 30 km Vakkotavare-Saltoluokta road/transfer stage, usually bus to Kebnats and M/S Langas boat to Saltoluokta.

officialSources.name: STF Saltoluokta-Kvikkjokk route group
keyFindings: Lists 73 km and four stages.
Notes several lake crossings by arranged boat transport or rowing.
Stage 2 begins with boat trip across Kaskajaure and Kabtajaure; Stage 3 begins with row/motorboat over Laitaure.

officialSources.name: STF Kvikkjokk-Ammarnas route group
keyFindings: Lists 180 km in the summary and says this is the least hiked part.
Summary says 8 stages, but the page lists 9 stage headings.
Includes mandatory boat from Kvikkjokk over Sakkat, Riebnes boat, Kapellstrommen rowboat and optional booked boat Adolfstrom-Baverholmen.

officialSources.name: STF Ammarnas-Hemavan route group
keyFindings: Lists 78 km and six stages.
Runs through Vindelfjallen Nature Reserve.
Notes alternate Syter-Norra Sytertoppen route that requires solid hiking experience and good weather.

officialSources.name: Lansstyrelsen Norrbotten - Leder och stugor
keyFindings: Norrbotten's state trail system is managed by the County Administrative Board.
Kungsleden runs from Abisko to Hemavan and is Sweden's oldest and best-known hiking trail.
Rowboat routes on Kungsleden are at Laitaure, Hornavan near Jackvik, and Teusajaure.
Rowboats are normally in place by July 1 and remain until the end of September.
Sitojaure rowboats are discontinued until further notice; use commercial boat traffic.
Commercial boat traffic is required over Sakkat and Riebnes on the southern Norrbotten part.

officialSources.name: Lansstyrelsen Norrbotten - Naturkartan
keyFindings: Norrbottens Naturkarta is the County Administrative Board guide to the state trail system, national parks and nature reserves in Norrbotten.
It contains descriptions of every Kungsleden section with text, pictures and map information.

officialSources.name: Lansstyrelsen Vasterbotten - Vandringsleder
keyFindings: Ammarnas-Hemavan is in Vindelfjallen Nature Reserve, one of Europe's largest protected areas.
Five STF mountain cabins lie along the Ammarnas-Hemavan section.
Kungsleden is managed and maintained by Lansstyrelsen Vasterbotten in Storuman and Sorsele municipalities; STF operates overnight cabins.

officialSources.name: Lansstyrelsen Vasterbotten - Naturkartan
keyFindings: Naturkartan includes Vasterbotten nature reserves, national parks, state mountain trails, rest places, wind shelters and overnight cabins.
The county recommends carrying paper map and compass for mountain hiking.

officialSources.name: STF Boats in the mountains
keyFindings: Page last updated 2025-07-05 and applies until further notice.
North of Kvikkjokk, boat crossings are needed at Aktse, Sitojaure, Saltoluokta and Teusajaure.
Sitojaure no longer has rowing boats from summer 2021.
Cash/card/payment details and dates vary; every boat crossing must be verified per section.

officialSectionOrder.name: Abiskojaure-Alesjaure
officialSectionOrder.connectionNotes: Optional Alesjaure boat can shorten the hike by about 6 km.

officialSectionOrder.name: Tjaktja-Salka
officialSectionOrder.connectionNotes: Highest point of Kungsleden at Tjaktjapasset, about 1150 m.

officialSectionOrder.name: Salka-Singi
officialSectionOrder.connectionNotes: Singi is the junction with the non-main Kebnekaise-Nikkaluokta access route.

officialSectionOrder.name: Teusajaure-Vakkotavare
officialSectionOrder.connectionNotes: Begins with Teusajaure boat/rowboat crossing; enters Stora Sjofallet National Park.

officialSectionOrder.name: Saltoluokta-Sitojaure
officialSectionOrder.connectionNotes: Requires separate Vakkotavare-Kebnats-Saltoluokta transfer before this section when walking north-to-south.

officialSectionOrder.name: Sitojaure-Aktse
officialSectionOrder.connectionNotes: Begins with commercial boat across Kaskajaure/Kabtajaure; former Sitojaure rowboat route is discontinued.

officialSectionOrder.name: Aktse-Parte
officialSectionOrder.connectionNotes: Begins with Laitaure rowboat or motorboat crossing; enters Sarek National Park.

officialSectionOrder.name: Kvikkjokk-Tsielekjakkstugan
officialSectionOrder.connectionNotes: Begins with about 3 km commercial boat over Sakkat from Kvikkjokk to Mallenjarka; no rowboats.

officialSectionOrder.name: Gasaklahko-Vuonatjviken
officialSectionOrder.connectionNotes: Crosses Arctic Circle shortly before Vuonatjviken.

officialSectionOrder.name: Vuonatjviken-Jackvik
officialSectionOrder.connectionNotes: Includes 5.4 km boat across Riebnes and 400 m rowboat over Kapellstrommen; STF distance field separates 5.4 km boat plus 18 km hiking.

officialSectionOrder.name: Jackvik-Adolfstrom
officialSectionOrder.connectionNotes: Passes Pieljekaise National Park and ends with gravel road into Adolfstrom.

officialSectionOrder.name: Adolfstrom-Sjnulttjie shelter
officialSectionOrder.connectionNotes: Can be shortened by about 8 km by pre-booked boat Adolfstrom-Baverholmen; enters Tjalmejaure bird protection area before Sjnulttjie.

officialSectionOrder.name: Tarnasjo-Syter
officialSectionOrder.connectionNotes: Crosses the Tarnasjo archipelago by seven bridges.

officialSectionOrder.name: Syter-Viterskalet
officialSectionOrder.connectionNotes: Official alternate via Norra Sytertoppen requires solid hiking experience and good weather.

officialSectionOrder.name: Viterskalet-Hemavan
officialSectionOrder.connectionNotes: Several route options near Hemavan; many hikers end at Hemavan Naturum, the southern Kungsleden gateway.

general: Mountain weather, snowmelt and high flows can change quickly; check SMHI, local reports and county/current trail pages before relying on summer trail assumptions.
Reindeer herding is active along Kungsleden; official STF pages repeatedly ask hikers to avoid disturbing reindeer.
National park and protected-area regulations override general right of public access where stricter.
Check current fire bans with the county administrative board or municipality before making fires.

camping.rule: Camping is prohibited except at designated places; listed tent sites include STF Abisko, Nissonjohka 5 km south of Abisko along Kungsleden, and Abiskojaure cabins.
Camping rules vary by park; check each park's page.

fire.rule: Fires and grills only at designated places; camping stoves are allowed.
If a county administrative board or municipality issues a fire ban, fires are not allowed anywhere in the national park.
Lansstyrelsen Vasterbotten says rest shelters are for rests/emergency shelter, not planned overnight stays; wood stoves/wood in rest shelters only for emergency heat in accident or severe weather.

dogs.rule: Dogs generally prohibited, but leashed dogs are allowed Jan 1-Apr 30 throughout the park and all year along roads/marked trails including Kungsleden and near STF Abisko/Abiskojaure.
Unofficial English Laponia regulations allow leashed dogs all year along Kungsleden in Stora Sjofallet/Stuor Muorkke and Sarek; official Swedish regulation prevails if inconsistent.
Dogs always on leash; generally allowed Jan 1-Apr 30, but leashed dogs may accompany hikers on Kungsleden all year.

seasonalAndCurrentness.rule: Norrbotten rowboats are normally placed by July 1 and remain until the end of September; some seasonal bridges elsewhere in the state trail system follow similar summer timing, but each Kungsleden crossing must be verified.
STF boats page was last updated 2025-07-05 and says it applies until further notice, but timetables/fares and operator status must be checked near use.

Lansstyrelsen Norrbotten posts current operating information for the state trail system at Aktuellt i fjallen; on 2026-04-29 it still showed winter/ice marking context and spring transition risk, not summer status.

sourceContradictionsAndRisks.summary: STF route-group pages include Nikkaluokta/Kebnekaise access stages, but STF explicitly says Singi-Nikkaluokta is not part of official Kungsleden.
sourceContradictionsAndRisks.decisionForCandidate: Exclude Singi-Kebnekaise-Nikkaluokta from mainline sections and preserve it as access connector metadata.

sourceContradictionsAndRisks.summary: STF lists Vakkotavare-Saltoluokta as a 30 km stage but also says the common option is bus to Kebnats plus M/S Langas boat.
sourceContradictionsAndRisks.decisionForCandidate: Model as transfer/connection metadata, not a normal hiking section unless a later import profile intentionally supports road transfers.

sourceContradictionsAndRisks.summary: STF summary says Kvikkjokk-Ammarnas has 8 stages, while the page lists 9 stage headings.
sourceContradictionsAndRisks.decisionForCandidate: Use the 9 listed section headings until Phase 2 finds official correction.

sourceContradictionsAndRisks.summary: Official total distance claims mix hiking distance, road/bus transfer, and boat crossings. The candidate mainline section sum is lower than the common 450+ km trail headline.
sourceContradictionsAndRisks.decisionForCandidate: Track per-section hiking distance separately from connection/boat/transfer distance.

sourceContradictionsAndRisks.summary: Older reports may mention Sitojaure rowboats. Current Lansstyrelsen/STF information says the rowboat route was discontinued from 2021 and hikers use commercial boat traffic.
sourceContradictionsAndRisks.decisionForCandidate: Suppress Sitojaure rowboat records unless later current official evidence reverses this.

sourceContradictionsAndRisks.summary: Some official Naturkartan route pages expose downloadable GPX, but some early Norrbotten section GPX URLs returned HTTP 500 on 2026-04-29.
sourceContradictionsAndRisks.decisionForCandidate: Each section file must record exact geometry availability and confidence.

sourceContradictionsAndRisks.summary: Boat, bus, hut, bridge and rowboat availability is seasonal and operator-specific.
sourceContradictionsAndRisks.decisionForCandidate: Record exact dates and accessed dates for all transit/boat claims; use live operator pages during section research.
